terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Basic conditions for using the Daily Device shopping demo.

sections.title: Portfolio Demo Notice
items: This service is a demo built for portfolio and feature demonstration purposes and does not provide real e-commerce transactions.
Product purchases, test payments, demo payments, orders, and shipping features are provided only to verify screens and flows. No real charges or product delivery will occur.
Do not enter real payment information, real shipping addresses, or sensitive personal information when using this service.

sections.title: Service Use
items: Members may use shopping features such as product browsing, cart, order, and checkout flows.
Some features may be changed or temporarily suspended when needed to keep the demo stable.

sections.title: Member Responsibilities
items: Members should provide accurate information and must not use another person's account or payment method without permission.
Actions that disrupt service operation or use features for improper purposes may be restricted.

sections.title: Orders and Payments
items: Order information created in the checkout flow is recorded only to demonstrate demo functionality.
Demo payments confirm orders without external payment approval, and test payments also do not create real purchases or delivery.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Personal information handled by Daily Device to provide the demo service and the standards used to protect it.

sections.title: Portfolio Demo Service Notice
items: This is a portfolio demo service. Information entered by users may be stored to demonstrate features such as sign-up, login, cart, orders, and address management.
Entered information is used only to provide demo features, display screens, and verify functionality.
Do not enter real personal information, real addresses, real payment information, or sensitive information.

sections.title: Information Collected
items: Names, contact details, shipping addresses, payment-related information, and order information may be processed during sign-up and order flows.
Access records, device information, cart data, and wishlist data may be generated while using the service.

sections.title: Purpose of Use
items: Entered information is used for identity display, demo order submission, test payment flow verification, and shipping address UI implementation.
Usage records may be analyzed within the necessary scope to improve service quality and prevent improper use.

sections.title: Retention and Deletion
items: Personal information is deleted without delay after the purpose is fulfilled, and information legally required to be retained is kept for the required period.
Members may request access, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing for their personal information.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Cookies and similar technologies used by Daily Device to maintain login state and improve the demo service.

sections.title: Portfolio Demo Service Notice
items: This service is a demo for portfolio feature demonstration.
Cookies and browser storage may be used to provide demo features such as login state, theme settings, and cart state.

sections.title: Purpose of Cookies
items: Cookies may be used to maintain login sessions, manage cart state, and save user preferences.
Non-identifying usage information may be used to analyze performance and improve errors.

sections.title: Cookie Management
items: Users can block cookie storage or delete existing cookies through browser settings.
Blocking required cookies may limit some features such as login, orders, and checkout.

sections.title: Policy Changes
items: If the way cookies are used changes, updates will be announced on this page.
Important changes may be announced through appropriate in-service notices.
